name: SPARC Version 9 instruction set architecture
description: The SPARC Architecture Committee defined a 64-bit version of SPARC, specifying instructions, registers, virtual addressing, traps and the memory model. It retained binary compatibility for nonprivileged applications conforming to the 32-bit SPARC V8 application binary interface.

date.basis: SPARC International's errata identifies the first printing as 1994.

events.statement: SPARC International published the Version 9 architecture manual for the 64-bit specification.

evidence.supports: Defines the architecture and the scope of backward compatibility.

earliest_record.rationale: The first printing provides a dated publication of the specification. Earlier proposal or release dates remain to be checked.
